posts.title: No Needle Skin Clinic | Recovering delayed course intent

copy.default:
A course enquiry saying “not right now” still tells you something useful.

The outcome mattered enough for them to enquire. The timing just didn't work.

No Needle Skin Clinic gave us a strong example of why those enquiries shouldn't disappear into a newsletter list with no next step.

The 222Emails process revisited genuine past interest when the context had changed, restarted the conversation and created a clear route into a course place.

There is a big difference between chasing a lead and returning to relevant intent at the right time.

Most training businesses have more of the second sitting in their database than they realise.

posts.mediaAlt: 222Emails client case study for No Needle Skin Clinic showing a 14-day reactivation campaign for past course enquiries, enrolment conversations, booked places and attributable potential booking value.
